name: Python + Marimo Container
onCreateCommand:
sudo sh -c "grep -rl 'dl.yarnpkg.com' /etc/apt/sources.list /etc/apt/sources.list.d 2>/dev/null | xargs -r rm -f" && sudo apt update && sudo apt install --no-install-recommends -y software-properties-common dirmngr && wget -qO- https://cloud.r-project.org/bin/linux/ubuntu/marutter_pubkey.asc | sudo tee -a /etc/apt/trusted.gpg.d/cran_ubuntu_key.asc && sudo add-apt-repository -y "deb https://cloud.r-project.org/bin/linux/ubuntu $(lsb_release -cs)-cran40/" && sudo apt update && sudo apt install -y --no-install-recommends tesseract-ocr 'r-base=4.6.*' libharfbuzz-dev libfribidi-dev libcairo2-dev libmagick++-dev librsvg2-dev libqpdf-dev libxslt1-dev pandoc nano && curl -fsSL https://bun.sh/install | bash && export PATH="$HOME/.bun/bin:$PATH" && ~/.bun/bin/bun add -g opencode-ai && curl -LO https://quarto.org/download/latest/quarto-linux-amd64.deb && sudo apt install -y ./quarto-linux-amd64.deb && rm quarto-linux-amd64.deb && pip install radian && sudo sh -c 'printf "#!/bin/sh
radian "\$@"
true
" > /usr/local/bin/r && chmod +x /usr/local/bin/r' && python3 -m pip install uv && uv pip install --system --python python3 marimo ipykernel
postCreateCommand:
python3 -m pip install uv && uv pip install --system --python python3 marimo ipykernel pandas plotly statsmodels micropip groq python-dotenv dspy-ai playwright pymupdf pillow pytesseract nltk spacy wordcloud && playwright install chromium && sudo sh -c "grep -rl 'dl.yarnpkg.com' /etc/apt/sources.list /etc/apt/sources.list.d 2>/dev/null | xargs -r rm -f" && sudo apt update && playwright install-deps && sudo apt install -y tesseract-ocr r-base=4.3.3-* libharfbuzz-dev libfribidi-dev libcairo2-dev libmagick++-dev librsvg2-dev libqpdf-dev libxslt1-dev && pip install radian && sudo Rscript -e "dir.create('R_library', showWarnings=FALSE); .libPaths(c('R_library', .libPaths())); install.packages(c(    ), lib = 'R_library', repos='https://packagemanager.posit.co/cran/__linux__/noble/latest', dependencies=TRUE)" && sudo sh -c 'printf "#!/bin/sh
radian "\$@"
true
" > /usr/local/bin/r && chmod +x /usr/local/bin/r'
